reviews.title: Top-tier performance, but the current price is crazy
reviews.comment:
I've been testing the Silicon Power Storm RGB 32GB (2x16GB) 6000 MT/s kit, and I have to say, the performance is stellar. Whether you're pushing high frame rates in gaming or handling heavy productivity workloads, this RAM does not break a sweat. The timings are solid, the system stability is rock-hard, and the heat spreaders paired with the RGB make for a really clean aesthetic in a windowed build.
My only major gripe has nothing to do with the hardware itself, but the market. Right now, the pricing on this kit is absolutely off the charts. It’s a bitter pill to swallow at current retail rates. However, if you are patient and wait for the DDR5 market to normalize—specifically when this kit drops to around $80—it transforms from a pricey luxury into one of the best budget-to-performance kits on the market. Highly recommended for the performance, but buy strategically!
